brief: Family dental office in SE Portland, accepting new patients. We'd like to bring in locals for cleanings and exams. Only people within about 10 miles are any use to us.

profile.business_summary: Family dental office located in SE Portland seeking to attract local patients within a 10-mile radius for cleanings and exams.
stated_claims: Family dental office in SE Portland
Only people within about 10 miles are any use to us
profile.fulfillment_notes: In-person local service in SE Portland (within a 10-mile radius).

relevant_tags.why: Dental cleanings and exams are essential health and wellness services.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Requires booking an appointment and physically traveling to a location in SE Portland rather than an instant online transaction.

note_signals.why: Studiogrid's audience is actively booking appointments and spending on self-care, which aligns with dental exams, though geo-restrictions limit utility.

profile.gate_reason: The advertiser is a local brick-and-mortar service business requiring hyper-local targeting (within 10 miles). Disco is a post-purchase network for DTC e-commerce brands with national reach. A local dental service cannot be purchased or fulfilled online for a national audience.
